roadmap.title: Professional campaign and emblems
roadmap.description: Complete Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Professional so all four difficulty achievements stack. Follow the 80-emblem route, rotate to character-specific weapons, and attempt each chapter-specific objective during its campaign chapter.

roadmap.title: Campaign cleanup and grinds
roadmap.description: Use Chapter Select, Records, Mercenaries, and the saved Chris Chapter 5 farm to finish weapon kills, combat counters, enemy totals, skill upgrades, medals, and any missed chapter objective.

roadmap.title: Onslaught boosting
roadmap.description: With one partner, win on three maps, build the 30-chain, send 2,000 enemies, earn ten sent-enemy defeats, and coordinate the Catacombs dying-state victory.

roadmap.title: Survivors boosting
roadmap.description: Use two-player Deathmatch for the streak, agent kills, and physical-only win. Add a third total player for the two Team Deathmatch achievements.

roadmap.title: Predator boosting
roadmap.description: Use Steel Beast with one or two partners to rotate Ustanak defeats, the no-capture and lone-agent wins, the sub-minute Ustanak kill, and 50 repeated captures.

roadmap.title: Siege boosting
roadmap.description: Use private Catacombs matches to farm agent, creature, and BSAA defeats, then finish the flawless creature and human rounds and reach ten total victories.

achievements.description: Complete the tutorial.
achievements.summary: Finish the mandatory @loc{Prelude} tutorial that opens a new game before the main menu appears.

guide.context: The Prelude launches automatically on the first playthrough and serves as the game's controls tutorial.

steps.text: Start a new game, complete every prompted action in @loc{Prelude}, and continue until the tutorial results and achievement appear.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1 in Leon's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Leon Chapter 1} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This is the first of Leon's five mandatory chapter milestones and also records progress toward the four full-campaign difficulty achievements.

steps.text: Select Leon's campaign, finish @loc{Chapter 1}, and reach the chapter-completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2 in Leon's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Leon Chapter 2} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The cathedral objective and its underground route are mandatory; the chapter can be replayed later through Chapter Select.

steps.text: Continue Leon's campaign through @loc{Chapter 2} and reach the chapter-completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3 in Leon's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Leon Chapter 3} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This chapter's cave and water sequences lie on Leon's main route, so no optional branch controls the unlock.

steps.text: Finish every mandatory objective in @loc{Leon Chapter 3} and reach its completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4 in Leon's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Leon Chapter 4} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Leon Chapter 4 includes the aircraft and Chinese market sections; completing the whole chapter records its selected difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Leon Chapter 4} and remain in the session until the chapter results appear.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5 in Leon's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Leon Chapter 5} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This is Leon's campaign finale and the fifth Leon chapter required for each whole-game difficulty clear.

steps.text: Complete the final objectives and boss sequence in @loc{Leon Chapter 5}, then reach the results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1 in Chris' campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 1} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The hostage operation starts Chris's five-chapter campaign and contributes one chapter to the selected difficulty record.

steps.text: Select Chris's campaign, finish @loc{Chapter 1}, and reach the chapter-completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2 in Chris' campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 2} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This mandatory Edonia operation can be replayed through Chapter Select for Piers's weapon and emblem tasks.

steps.text: Finish all mandatory objectives in @loc{Chris Chapter 2} and reach its completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3 in Chris' campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 3} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The chapter's pursuit and helicopter encounters all belong to the required story route.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 3} and continue until the chapter results appear.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4 in Chris' campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 4} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The aircraft-carrier operation ends with the VTOL sequence used for Flying Ace, making this a useful chapter to revisit for cleanup.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chris Chapter 4}, including the final VTOL sequence, and reach the results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5 in Chris' campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Chris Chapter 5} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Chris's finale contains the timed cocoon room used for the most efficient documented skill-point farm.

steps.text: Complete the laboratory route and final encounter in @loc{Chris Chapter 5}, then reach the chapter results.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1 in Jake's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 1} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This begins Jake and Sherry's five-chapter campaign and establishes one of the four campaign records needed for difficulty completion.

steps.text: Select Jake's campaign, finish @loc{Chapter 1}, and reach the chapter-completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2 in Jake's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 2} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The mountain, avalanche, and Oko sequences are mandatory portions of Jake's second chapter.

steps.text: Finish every mandatory objective in @loc{Jake Chapter 2} and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3 in Jake's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 3} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Jake Chapter 3 supplies Sherry's early Stun Rod farm and one emblem available only through Jake's security cameras.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 3} and continue until the chapter-completion screen appears.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4 in Jake's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 4} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The helicopter encounter used for Hard Choice occurs after the motorcycle sequence within this mandatory chapter.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Jake Chapter 4}, including the helicopter and city sequences, and reach the results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5 in Jake's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Jake Chapter 5} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This is Jake and Sherry's finale and completes their five-chapter contribution to each whole-game difficulty achievement.

steps.text: Complete the power-restoration route and final Ustanak encounter in @loc{Jake Chapter 5}, then reach the results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1 in Ada's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 1} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Ada's campaign contains five chapters of its own and is required alongside Leon, Chris, and Jake for full difficulty completion.

steps.text: Select Ada's campaign, finish @loc{Chapter 1}, and reach the chapter-completion screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2 in Ada's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 2} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Ada's cemetery and laboratory route intersects Leon's story but maintains a separate chapter-completion record.

steps.text: Finish all mandatory objectives in @loc{Ada Chapter 2} and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3 in Ada's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 3} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The market, bus, and train sequences are all required portions of Ada's third chapter.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 3} and continue until the chapter-completion screen appears.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4 in Ada's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 4} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The aircraft-carrier bridge section used for Sneaking Around lies inside this chapter and can be retried through Chapter Select.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Ada Chapter 4} and reach the chapter results, regardless of whether the stealth bonus was earned.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5 in Ada's campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Ada Chapter 5} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Ada's finale is the twentieth and final chapter needed for a complete four-campaign difficulty record.

steps.text: Complete every mandatory objective in @loc{Ada Chapter 5} and reach the campaign results.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game on Amateur.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 chapters across Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Amateur difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Difficulty achievements stack, so a full Professional completion awards Amateur, Normal, and Veteran at the same time.

steps.text: Finish all five chapters in each of the four campaigns on Amateur or a higher difficulty.
Use Chapter Select or Records to confirm every chapter has a qualifying completion and clear any missing chapter.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game on Normal.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 chapters across Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Normal difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Each chapter stores its highest cleared difficulty, and the selected difficulty may be changed between chapters without invalidating previous records.

steps.text: Finish all five chapters for Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Normal, Veteran, or Professional.
Check Chapter Select or Records and replay every chapter whose stored difficulty is below Normal.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game on Veteran.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 chapters across Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Veteran difficulty or higher.

guide.context: A Professional route is the shortest one-playthrough option because it satisfies Veteran and both lower difficulty achievements.

steps.text: Complete every chapter in all four campaigns on Veteran or Professional.
Review the chapter difficulty records and replay any chapter without a Veteran-or-higher clear.

achievements.description: Complete the entire game on Professional.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 chapters across Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada on Professional difficulty.

guide.context: Professional is unlocked from the start. Enemies have more health and damage while QTE timers are shorter; Chapter Select preserves each chapter's best difficulty independently.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Professional} and finish all five Leon chapters, all five Chris chapters, all five Jake chapters, and all five Ada chapters.
Open Chapter Select or Records, inspect the highest difficulty recorded for every chapter, and replay each chapter missing a Professional clear.
Complete the last outstanding Professional chapter to receive this achievement plus any unfinished lower-difficulty achievements.

achievements.description: Customize your dog tags.
achievements.summary: Open Play Game -> Dog Tags and change one template, emblem, or title after unlocking a customization option.

guide.context: Chapter completions unlock templates, achievements unlock emblems, and in-game title challenges unlock titles; changing only one category is sufficient.

steps.text: Complete a chapter, earn an achievement, or earn a title so at least one new dog-tag option exists.
From the main menu, open @loc{Play Game -> Dog Tags}, change one template, emblem, or title, and confirm the selection.

achievements.description: Earn 10 different titles.
achievements.summary: Earn ten distinct in-game titles, then open Play Game -> Dog Tags to register the unlock.

guide.context: Resident Evil 6 contains 135 titles tied to ordinary challenges such as movement, headshots, weapon kills, and chapter completions.

steps.text: Play campaign normally until at least ten different title challenges have been completed.
At the title screen, enter @loc{Play Game -> Dog Tags}; loading that menu checks the title total and awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Purchase one skill.
achievements.summary: Spend skill points to purchase any one skill from the skill menu.

guide.context: Enemies and campaign containers award skill points, and this achievement requires a purchase rather than merely collecting the currency.

steps.text: Earn enough skill points for an available skill, open the skill menu, purchase that skill, and confirm the transaction.

achievements.description: Max out all the skills that allow you to level up.
achievements.summary: Spend 954,000 skill points to fully upgrade the 12 skills marked with level ranks.

guide.context: Only skills displaying a @mechanic{Lv.} rank count. Chris Chapter 5's timed cocoon room can release as many as ten B.O.W.s carrying 1,500- or 2,500-point pieces per farming pass.

collectibles.name: Firearm Lv. 3
collectibles.method: Buy all three Firearm ranks for 12,000, 29,000, and 75,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Melee Lv. 3
collectibles.method: Buy all three Melee ranks for 10,000, 25,000, and 75,000 skill points.

collectibles.method: Buy all three Defense ranks for 3,200, 28,000, and 80,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Lock-On Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Lock-On ranks for 2,800 and 31,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Rock Steady Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Rock Steady ranks for 3,500 and 33,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Critical Hit Lv. 3
collectibles.method: Buy all three Critical Hit ranks for 3,500, 13,000, and 32,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Piercing Lv. 3
collectibles.method: Buy all three Piercing ranks for 12,000, 28,000, and 55,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: J'avo Killer Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both J'avo Killer ranks for 3,000 and 25,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Zombie Hunter Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Zombie Hunter ranks for 3,000 and 25,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Combat Gauge Boost Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Combat Gauge Boost ranks for 70,000 and 90,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Recovery Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Recovery ranks for 10,000 and 70,000 skill points.

collectibles.name: Field Medic Lv. 2
collectibles.method: Buy both Field Medic ranks for 12,000 and 95,000 skill points.

achievements.description: Use a stealth attack to take down five enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill five unaware enemies with stealth attacks from behind.

guide.context: A stealth attack is available only while the target remains unaware and the contextual physical-attack prompt is visible.

steps.text: Approach an unaware enemy from behind without alerting it.
Use the displayed physical-attack prompt to perform the stealth takedown, then earn five credited kills this way.

achievements.description: Perform a coup de grâce on ten enemies.
achievements.summary: Perform ten coup de grâce finishers on stunned or incapacitated enemies.

guide.context: Flash grenades expose ordinary zombies and J'avo to finishers, heavily damaged B.O.W.s kneel for the same attack, and some partner rescues also count.

steps.text: Use a @item{flash grenade} to stun a clustered set of ordinary zombies or J'avo.
Run beside each dazed enemy and use the displayed coup de grâce physical-attack prompt before the target recovers.
Continue until ten coup de grâce kills have been credited; kneeling B.O.W.s provide another valid target type.

achievements.description: Counter an enemy's attack three times in row.
achievements.summary: Counter three enemy attacks consecutively without performing another action between counters.

guide.context: Zombie attack wind-ups are slower and easier to read than most enemy animations, while any intervening action resets the three-counter sequence.

steps.text: Isolate a basic @enemy{zombie} and watch the wind-up for its melee strike.
Press the physical-attack control as the counter prompt appears, then land two more counters in succession without attacking, dodging, or using an item between them.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy while dying, then recover without any help.
achievements.summary: While Lone Wolf is equipped, kill the last nearby enemy from the dying state and recover without partner assistance.

guide.context: @mechanic{Lone Wolf} costs 100 skill points and prevents the AI partner from reviving the player, allowing the recovery gauge to finish naturally.

steps.text: Buy and equip @mechanic{Lone Wolf}, then enter an area with several weak enemies and kill all but one.
Let the remaining enemy exhaust the health gauge and force the dying state.
While lying on the ground, aim and shoot the remaining enemy, then wait without help until the recovery gauge fills completely.

achievements.description: Help or rescue your partner ten times.
achievements.summary: Use the rescue or help prompt on a grabbed partner ten times.

guide.context: A partner who needs rescue is marked by a flashing red circle, and the counter accumulates across campaign play.

steps.text: When an enemy grabs the partner and the flashing red indicator appears, move within rescue range.
Use the displayed help prompt to free the partner and reach ten successful rescues.

achievements.description: Use all the weapons in the game and kill ten enemies with each of them.
achievements.summary: Record ten kills with each of the 22 required campaign weapons, including every character-exclusive starting weapon.

guide.context: Several weapons belong to specific characters, so play briefly as every relevant character. A campaign weapon missed as a pickup is granted when that chapter is completed.

collectibles.name: Nine-Oh-Nine
collectibles.method: Use the Nine-Oh-Nine to land ten killing blows.

collectibles.name: Picador
collectibles.method: Play Helena and earn ten Picador kills.

collectibles.name: Wing Shooter
collectibles.method: Play Leon and earn ten Wing Shooter kills.

collectibles.name: Shotgun
collectibles.method: Use the standard Shotgun for ten kills.

collectibles.name: Assault Shotgun
collectibles.method: Use the Assault Shotgun for ten kills.

collectibles.name: Hydra
collectibles.method: Play Helena and earn ten Hydra kills.

collectibles.name: Lightning Hawk
collectibles.method: Use the Lightning Hawk to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Elephant Killer
collectibles.method: Use the Elephant Killer to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Sniper Rifle
collectibles.method: Use the Sniper Rifle to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Semi-Automatic Sniper Rifle
collectibles.method: Use the Semi-Automatic Sniper Rifle to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Anti-Materiel Rifle
collectibles.method: Play Piers and earn ten Anti-Materiel Rifle kills.

collectibles.name: Ammo Box 50
collectibles.method: Play Ada and earn ten Ammo Box 50 kills.

collectibles.name: Triple Shot
collectibles.method: Play Sherry and earn ten Triple Shot kills.

collectibles.name: MP-AF
collectibles.method: Play Piers and earn ten MP-AF kills.

collectibles.name: Assault Rifle for Special Tactics
collectibles.method: Play Chris and earn ten kills with the Assault Rifle for Special Tactics.

collectibles.name: Bear Commander
collectibles.method: Use the Bear Commander to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Assault Rifle RN
collectibles.method: Use the Assault Rifle RN to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Grenade Launcher
collectibles.method: Use the Grenade Launcher to earn ten kills.

collectibles.name: Crossbow
collectibles.method: Play Ada and earn ten Crossbow kills.

collectibles.name: Survival Knife
collectibles.method: Play Leon and land ten killing blows with the Survival Knife.

collectibles.name: Combat Knife
collectibles.method: Play Chris and land ten killing blows with the Combat Knife.

collectibles.name: Stun Rod
collectibles.method: Play Sherry and land ten killing blows with the Stun Rod.

achievements.description: Knock ten enemies off a high place.
achievements.summary: Use contextual physical attacks to throw ten enemies from high ledges.

guide.context: The throw prompt is position-sensitive, so both the player and target must be aligned beside an exposed drop rather than merely near elevated ground.

steps.text: Move beside an enemy standing at a ledge until the special physical-attack prompt appears.
Use the prompt to throw the enemy over the edge and earn ten credited falling kills.

achievements.description: Earn a level-four title.
achievements.summary: Raise any in-game title challenge to four stars, then open Play Game -> Dog Tags.

guide.context: A title's star count rises through repeated progress in its associated challenge, with four stars as the maximum rank.

steps.text: Continue campaign challenges until one title displays four stars.
At the title screen, enter @loc{Play Game -> Dog Tags}; visiting that menu registers the four-star title for the achievement.

achievements.description: Collect 3 figures.
achievements.summary: Shoot all four serpent emblems in three different chapters, then open Special Features -> Collections to claim three figures.

guide.context: Completing a chapter's four-emblem row unlocks one figure; the achievement triggers when the unlocked figures are viewed in Collections.

steps.text: Collect every serpent emblem in any three chapters, completing three four-emblem rows.
From the main menu, open @loc{Special Features -> Collections} and view the three unlocked figures.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with the Hydra using a quick shot.
achievements.summary: As Helena, kill 20 enemies with Hydra quick shots by pressing aim and fire together.

guide.context: Quick shots consume part of the combat gauge. Helena starts with the Hydra, and the first enemies in Leon Chapter 1's elevator provide the earliest repeatable targets.

steps.text: Play @npc{Helena} in @loc{Leon Chapter 1} or unlock her in Mercenaries, then equip the @item{Hydra}.
Press aim and fire simultaneously to perform a quick shot, allow the combat gauge to recover as needed, and land 20 killing quick shots.

achievements.description: Take down an enemy from 50 meters away with a headshot using the thermal scope.
achievements.summary: As Piers in Chris Chapter 2, score a thermal-scope headshot from at least 50 meters with the Anti-Materiel Rifle.

guide.context: The opening overturned vehicle creates a measured long sightline to an enemy in a distant window; a checkpoint restart restores the attempt after a miss.

steps.text: Start @loc{Chris Chapter 2} as @npc{Piers} and crawl out of the overturned vehicle.
Turn around, retreat as far as the route permits, equip the @item{Anti-Materiel Rifle}, and switch to its thermal scope.
Headshot the enemy visible in the distant window; restart the checkpoint if the shot misses or fails the 50-meter requirement.

achievements.description: Defeat ten enemies with a stun rod charge attack.
achievements.summary: As Sherry, kill ten enemies with fully charged Stun Rod attacks; Jake Chapter 3 on Amateur supplies an early farm.

guide.context: Sherry begins Jake Chapter 3 with the Stun Rod before her guns are recovered. Amateur lets the charged strike kill basic enemies reliably.

steps.text: Start @loc{Jake Chapter 3} on Amateur as @npc{Sherry} and ready the @item{Stun Rod}.
Hold the attack control through the initial staggering swing, then release the fully charged follow-up at melee range.
Reload the checkpoint to restore the opening enemies and continue until ten charged-attack kills are credited.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 zombies.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 zombies across campaign play, concentrating on Leon's chapters and the zombie sections in Ada's campaign.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, and Leon's campaign supplies the majority of zombie encounters needed for the total.

steps.text: Kill every @enemy{zombie} encountered while completing Leon's campaign and the zombie-heavy sections of Ada's campaign.
If the total remains below 500, replay zombie-dense campaign checkpoints until the achievement appears.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 J'avo.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 J'avo across campaign play, concentrating on Chris's and Jake's chapters.

guide.context: J'avo are the armed humanlike enemies that can mutate when particular body parts are damaged; Chris and Jake encounter them most often.

steps.text: Kill the @enemy{J'avo} encountered throughout Chris's and Jake's campaigns.
Replay J'avo-heavy chapters if the cumulative 500-kill total is not reached during the four campaign clears.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 enemies that have come out of a chrysalid.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 B.O.W.s after they fully emerge from chrysalids; destroying unopened cocoons does not count.

guide.context: Chris's campaign contains the greatest concentration of chrysalids, and the Chris Chapter 5 skill-point farm can release up to ten qualifying B.O.W.s per pass.

steps.text: When a human-shaped cocoon appears, wait until the transformed @enemy{B.O.W.} breaks out before dealing the killing damage.
For cleanup, replay Chris Chapter 5's timed circular room, activate the green levers, and kill the creatures released from up to ten cocoons.
Proceed until the Saving icon appears before quitting each farming pass, then repeat until 100 hatched B.O.W. kills are recorded.

achievements.description: Rescue two female survivors at the cathedral.
achievements.summary: In Leon Chapter 2's cathedral, kill the first Lepotitsa quickly enough that at least two female survivors remain human.

guide.context: The Lepotitsa encounter begins after the bell puzzles return Leon and Helena to the cathedral's main room; its gas converts nearby civilians into zombies.

steps.text: Play @loc{Leon Chapter 2} through the cathedral puzzles and ring the bells.
On returning to the main room, immediately focus all available gunfire on the first @enemy{Lepotitsa} while staying outside its gas cloud.
Kill the Lepotitsa before its gas transforms more civilians, leaving at least two women alive and human.

achievements.description: Pilot the VTOL without getting a scratch on it.
achievements.summary: Complete Chris Chapter 4's closing VTOL flight without the aircraft taking any damage.

guide.context: Either Chris or Piers can earn the achievement. Continuing after a death invalidates the clean run, while an immediate checkpoint restart preserves a fresh attempt.

steps.text: Reach the final @mechanic{VTOL} sequence in @loc{Chris Chapter 4} as Chris or Piers.
Dodge every missile and avoid all collisions while completing the full flight section.
If the screen flashes red from aircraft damage, immediately restart the checkpoint; after dying, do not select @warn{Yes} in the continuation dialogue.

achievements.description: Shoot the helicopter pilot with a Magnum at point-blank range.
achievements.summary: As Jake in Chapter 4, grab the helicopter's troop rope and complete the QTE that kills its pilot at point-blank range.

guide.context: The rope opportunity appears after the motorcycle section and the shared fight with Chris and Piers; the scripted QTE supplies the required Magnum shot.

steps.text: Play @loc{Jake Chapter 4} as @npc{Jake} through the motorcycle sequence and the battle fought alongside Chris and Piers.
When the objective changes to destroying the helicopter, kill the grasshopper J'avo and climb the area's ladders to the upper level.
Clear nearby enemies, stand beside the troop rope when the helicopter approaches to deploy reinforcements, and use the displayed grab prompt.
Complete every prompt in the resulting QTE so Jake reaches the pilot and fires the point-blank Magnum shot.

achievements.description: Get through the aircraft carrier's bridge area without being noticed.
achievements.summary: As Ada in Chapter 4, cross the aircraft-carrier bridge area without detection, using silent crossbow bolts for mandatory kills.

guide.context: The monitored section begins when Ada crosses paths with Chris and Piers. Gunfire or explosive bolts can alert guards, and accepting the post-death continuation invalidates the attempt.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Ada Chapter 4} with a supply of non-explosive @item{crossbow bolts}.
From the point where Ada crosses Chris and Piers, stay outside enemy sightlines and use silent bolts only on guards that must be removed.
If any guard detects Ada, restart the checkpoint immediately; after dying, do not select @warn{Yes} in the continuation dialogue.
Reach the end of the aircraft-carrier bridge area without an alert to receive the achievement.

achievements.description: Earn 150 different medals.
achievements.summary: Earn 150 distinct medals by varying kills, physical attacks, and objectives across all available game modes.

guide.context: There are 264 medals in total, and medals from campaign and every extra mode feed the same 150-medal requirement.

steps.text: Vary weapons, physical attacks, enemy types, stage actions, and match results while completing the campaign and multiplayer achievements.
Review the medal list, identify unearned actions, and deliberately complete new medal conditions until 150 different medals have registered.

achievements.description: Collect all the serpent emblems.
achievements.summary: Shoot all 80 serpent emblems: four in every chapter of Leon, Chris, Jake, and Ada.

guide.context: Each emblem saves immediately when shot, so cleanup can return to the menu without reaching another checkpoint. @loc{Special Features -> Collections} shows chapters as rows and the four emblems in appearance order.

collectibles.name: Leon 1-1
collectibles.method: Before leaving the room where Leon meets Liz's father, circle the computer table and shoot the emblem inside the open cabinet.

collectibles.name: Leon 1-2
collectibles.method: After the alarmed corridor horde, search the third office on the campus-keycard route and open the desk drawer containing the emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 1-3
collectibles.method: After the flashlight failure and return to the rails, look beneath the train carriage on the right.

collectibles.name: Leon 1-4
collectibles.method: After helping Helena open the door into the bar, turn left before using the exit and shoot the emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 2-1
collectibles.method: Find the green arrow sign, move behind it to the obelisk-shaped grave, and shoot the emblem behind that grave.

collectibles.name: Leon 2-2
collectibles.method: Walk to the altar, turn around, look high above the nave, and shoot the emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 2-3
collectibles.method: While Helena runs through the numbered-room basement, enter the left bathroom, use the sink to drain it, and shoot the revealed emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 2-4
collectibles.method: Crawl beneath the low stone arch, then immediately look left into the inaccessible area and shoot the emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 3-1
collectibles.method: Before entering the first door, look high to its left and shoot the emblem.

collectibles.name: Leon 3-2
collectibles.method: After the first sighting of the water monster, leave the water at the first dry section and open the coffin on the left.

collectibles.name: Leon 3-3
collectibles.method: While playing Leon and covering Helena from long range, locate and shoot the emblem from the firing position.

collectibles.name: Leon 3-4
collectibles.method: After Helena covers Leon's water-monster escape, turn right, climb the ladder, and backtrack to the bucket with ammunition.

collectibles.name: Leon 4-1
collectibles.method: At the ladder leading into the cockpit, look left and shoot the emblem before climbing.

collectibles.name: Leon 4-2
collectibles.method: Before the second gas-monster fight, inspect the glass cabinet in the room containing a chest.

collectibles.name: Leon 4-3
collectibles.method: After the market cutscene, enter the alley on the right and look into the shop on the right.

collectibles.name: Leon 4-4
collectibles.method: When Leon boosts Helena to another roof during the three-key search, look high and slightly right.

collectibles.name: Leon 5-1
collectibles.method: Search the shop shelves and shoot the emblem among them.

collectibles.name: Leon 5-2
collectibles.method: Enter the alley after the helicopter sequence, walk to the jeep, and look left.

collectibles.name: Leon 5-3
collectibles.method: After escaping the helicopter crash through the glass floor, approach the next door and look right.

achievements.description: Send 2,000 enemies to your opponent's map.
achievements.summary: In Onslaught, send a cumulative 2,000 enemies to opponents by completing combo chains.

guide.context: Onslaught is a one-on-one mode where completed combos transfer enemies to the opposing map. The cumulative total is visible under Records -> Extra Content -> Onslaught.

steps.text: Start coordinated @mechanic{Onslaught} matches with one partner and build the longest safe enemy combo in each wave.
Complete each combo so the accumulated enemies transfer to the opponent's map, then keep each match active until the timer ends.
Check @loc{Records -> Extra Content -> Onslaught} and continue until the sent-enemy total reaches 2,000.

achievements.description: Defeat your opponent and achieve victory in 3 stages.
achievements.summary: Win Onslaught matches on three different stages.

guide.context: The requirement tracks distinct maps, so multiple victories on the same stage count only once toward the three-stage total.

steps.text: Create an @mechanic{Onslaught} match with a partner, choose the first stage, and defeat the opponent.
Change to a second stage and win again, then select a third distinct stage and earn the third victory.

achievements.description: Achieve a 30-combo chain.
achievements.summary: Build a 30-kill combo in Onslaught before the combo timer expires.

guide.context: Reaching 30 consecutive zombie or J'avo kills cashes the chain into a wave sent to the opponent's map.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Onslaught} match and kill zombies or J'avo quickly enough to keep the combo timer active.
Reach a displayed 30-combo without allowing the chain to break; the transfer and achievement occur when the chain is completed.

achievements.description: Defeat your opponent 10 times with enemies you sent.
achievements.summary: In Onslaught, let enemies sent from your map deliver the opponent's fatal damage ten times.

guide.context: Transferred enemies have a green outline. Urban Chaos is useful because Bloodshots and Zombie Dogs can finish a weakened opponent quickly.

steps.text: Start a coordinated @mechanic{Onslaught} match on @loc{Urban Chaos} and have the receiving player lower their health early.
On the scoring side, grow the combo counter to 15 or higher, then complete the chain to transfer the wave.
Have the weakened opponent avoid killing the green-outlined transferred enemies and allow those enemies to inflict the fatal blow.
Repeat the sent-enemy defeat until ten opponent losses are credited to transferred enemies.

achievements.description: Win while in the dying state.
achievements.summary: Win an Onslaught match while your character is still in the dying state.

guide.context: The Catacombs spike traps let both players control when they enter the dying state, making the order of the two knockdowns predictable.

steps.text: Start a coordinated @mechanic{Onslaught} match on @loc{Catacombs} and position both players beside separate spike traps.
Have the losing player enter a trap first and begin losing health while downed.
About five seconds later, have the intended winner enter the other trap and remain in the dying state.
Let the first player die while the winner is still downed so the match ends with the winner in the dying state.

achievements.description: Win five times in a row.
achievements.summary: Win five consecutive private Survivors Deathmatches without another player breaking the streak.

guide.context: A two-player Deathmatch ends as soon as one participant dies, allowing the five-match streak to be boosted quickly.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Survivors} lobby, select @mechanic{Deathmatch}, and invite one partner.
Have the partner allow one kill so the match ends immediately in the target player's favor.
Rematch and earn four more uninterrupted victories for five consecutive wins.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 agents.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 player agents in Survivors matches.

guide.context: Survivors supports up to six players. A larger boosting group speeds the total; four players rotating kills on Urban Chaos require roughly four hours for everyone.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Survivors} lobby on @loc{Urban Chaos} and have every participant choose an Agent character.
Gather the non-scoring players on the center bridge and let the active player kill them with the Agent's Magnum.
Rotate the scoring role after each match and continue until the target account records 100 agent kills.

achievements.description: Survive to the end only using physical attacks.
achievements.summary: Win a Survivors Deathmatch as Jake using only hand-to-hand physical attacks.

guide.context: The physical-only restriction applies to the entire winning match, and the documented route uses Jake's dedicated hand-to-hand style against one partner.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Survivors Deathmatch} with one opponent and select @npc{Jake}.
Do not fire or strike with any weapon; defeat the opponent entirely with Jake's hand-to-hand physical attacks and survive until the match ends.

achievements.description: Return to the game as a human character.
achievements.summary: In a three-player Survivors Team Deathmatch, respawn as a creature, kill the solo opponent, and return as a human.

guide.context: This setup needs three total players: two teammates on one side and one opponent. A killed agent returns temporarily as a zombie or J'avo.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Survivors Team Deathmatch} with two players on the target team and one player alone on the opposing team.
Have the solo opponent kill the target player so that player respawns as a zombie or J'avo.
As the respawned creature, kill the solo opponent and return to the match as a human character.

achievements.description: Win without any members of your team being killed.
achievements.summary: Win a three-player Survivors Team Deathmatch without either member of the two-player team dying.

guide.context: The smallest valid setup uses two players on the winning team and one cooperating opponent; one death on the winning side invalidates the round.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Survivors Team Deathmatch} with two players on one team and one player on the opposing team.
Have the two-player team kill the solo opponent before that opponent kills either teammate.
Let the match end immediately with both winning teammates still alive.

achievements.description: Defeat Ustanak 20 times.
achievements.summary: Defeat Ustanak 20 times as an agent in Predator matches.

guide.context: Steel Beast places the agents and Ustanak close together beneath the bridge, and a two-player lobby lets partners alternate the scoring role.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Predator} match with one partner on @loc{Steel Beast}.
As the agent, choose Leon, Agent, or another character with a shotgun or Magnum and immediately kill the player controlling @enemy{Ustanak}.
Trade roles for the next match and continue until the target player has defeated Ustanak 20 times.

achievements.description: Defeat Ustanak without anyone on your team being captured.
achievements.summary: In Predator, defeat Ustanak before any agent on the team is captured.

guide.context: A two-player match on Steel Beast minimizes both travel time and the number of agents who could be captured.

steps.text: Start a two-player @mechanic{Predator} match on @loc{Steel Beast} and take the agent role.
Use a shotgun or Magnum to kill the opposing @enemy{Ustanak} immediately, before Ustanak grabs and captures the agent.

achievements.description: Eliminate all players as Ustanak in less than a minute.
achievements.summary: As Ustanak on Steel Beast, kill the only opposing agent within 60 seconds.

guide.context: Steel Beast is small enough for Ustanak and the lone agent to engage immediately in a two-player match.

steps.text: Start a two-player @mechanic{Predator} match on @loc{Steel Beast} and take the @enemy{Ustanak} role.
Rush the single agent as the round begins and kill that player with grabs or charging attacks before 60 seconds elapse.

achievements.description: As Ustanak, capture a total of 50 humans.
achievements.summary: As Ustanak, accumulate 50 captures by repeatedly grabbing an agent whom a second agent frees.

guide.context: The counter increases on each capture rather than requiring 50 different victims, so the same agent can be freed and captured again.

steps.text: Create a three-player @mechanic{Predator} match on @loc{Steel Beast}, with the target player controlling @enemy{Ustanak}.
Grab one agent while the second agent waits directly behind Ustanak.
Have the second agent free the captive, then immediately capture the same agent again until 50 captures are recorded.

achievements.description: Defeat Ustanak with only one Agent remaining.
achievements.summary: As the only agent in a two-player Predator match, defeat Ustanak so one Agent remains at victory.

guide.context: A one-agent team automatically satisfies the final-survivor condition as long as that player defeats Ustanak.

steps.text: Create a two-player @mechanic{Predator} match on @loc{Steel Beast} and take the sole agent slot.
Kill the opposing @enemy{Ustanak} with a shotgun or Magnum while the lone agent remains active.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 player-controlled agents and 100 player-controlled creatures.
achievements.summary: In Siege, kill 100 player agents and 100 creatures; AI-controlled creature kills also count toward the creature total.

guide.context: The achievement description overstates the creature restriction. Both counters can be checked under Records -> Extra Content -> Siege.

steps.text: Create a two-player @mechanic{Siege} match on @loc{Catacombs} with one private slot.

For agent kills, have the zombie discard its starting weapon, catch the player agent in the crank-operated spike trap, and turn the crank again while the agent is dying; use a physical finisher if the agent falls clear.
Kill player-controlled agents until that counter reaches 100, and kill any player- or AI-controlled creatures until the creature counter reaches 100.
Confirm both totals under @loc{Records -> Extra Content -> Siege}.

achievements.description: Defeat the BSAA 100 times.
achievements.summary: Defeat the BSAA rookie 100 times in Siege, using the Catacombs spike trap to farm both players' totals.

guide.context: Positioning both the player agent and rookie near the trap center lets one crank activation down the agent and kill the rookie; beginning near 2:30 leaves time to rotate roles.

steps.text: Create a two-player @mechanic{Siege} match on @loc{Catacombs} with one private slot.
As the player agent, lure the BSAA rookie into the center of the spike trap while the creature waits at the crank.
At about 2:30 remaining, have the creature turn the crank and continue operating it if the rookie survives the first activation.
Rotate roles so both players score, and track the cumulative total under @loc{Records -> Extra Content -> Siege -> BSAA Agents Defeated} until it reaches 100.

achievements.description: Defeat the BSAA as a creature without dying once.
achievements.summary: As a Siege creature, personally finish the BSAA rookie and win the round without dying.

guide.context: Only the creature player who lands the rookie's final blow receives credit. Helena's grenades let the human side weaken the rookie without killing the scoring creature.

steps.text: Create a private @mechanic{Siege} match and arrange for the target player to begin on the Creature team.
Have a human partner choose @npc{Helena} and use grenades to weaken the BSAA rookie without landing the kill.
As the creature, avoid dying, deliver the rookie's final blow personally, and remain alive until the round ends.

achievements.displayName: Two Sides of the Same Coin
achievements.description: Win 10 times.
achievements.summary: Win ten Siege rounds across any combination of Human-team and Creature-team victories.

guide.context: The two team types share one cumulative win counter, so no separate set of ten victories is required for each side.

steps.text: Play or boost @mechanic{Siege} matches and complete each round on the winning Human or Creature team.
Accumulate ten total round victories across both team roles.

achievements.description: Protect the BSAA without any of them getting hurt.
achievements.summary: As the Human team in Siege, protect every BSAA member from all damage until the round ends.

guide.context: Round two lasts only as long as the BSAA rookie survived round one, so a deliberately short first round creates a brief flawless-defense window.

steps.text: Create a coordinated @mechanic{Siege} match and let the Creature team kill the BSAA rookie within roughly 15-30 seconds in round one.
When teams switch for round two, keep every creature away from the rookie and prevent all damage for the same short duration.
Finish the round with the rookie and every BSAA member completely unharmed.
